name: 117-interactive-llama2-7b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf -- an ungated re-upload of Llama-2-7b-chat with identical weights and config; the meta-llama repo is gated.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, no GQA, 4096-token window, fp16 -- 13.5 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 800 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: prompts 256 +- 32 tokens (clamped 128-384), generations 256 +- 32 tokens (clamped 128-384). Seed 42.
purpose: A single-turn chat assistant on a 7-billion-parameter model, serving 16 concurrent users short prompts and replies on one GPU.
launch:
# The sglang server's command line.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- the reader skips indented lines, so a structured value must stay on
# one line or it is dropped silently.
# This era's ServerArgs is small and `parse_args()` REJECTS unknown flags: a key copied from a
# later sglang fails bring-up rather than being ignored.

model-path: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
tp-size: 1
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
stream-interval: 8
random-seed: 42
